firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently dug a hole starts.
clarifications: The player to their right chooses which side of the first game board faces up.
internalEvidence: The Roxley rulebook explicitly chooses the most recent hole digger before game-area setup on PDF page 2. The same passage assigns the board-side choice to that player’s right-hand neighbor; the cover credits Roxley and the title matches inventory BGG 162286.
